cards.example_en: She was in luck and found a seat on the crowded bus.
cards.example_zh: 她运气不错，在拥挤的公交车上找到了座位。

cards.example_en: We preserve old family photographs in a special album.
cards.example_zh: 我们把家里的老照片保存在一本专用相册里。
cards.explain_zh: preserve强调保持原状；保藏食物也用它。

cards.example_en: We split the cake and shared it with our neighbours.
cards.example_zh: 我们把蛋糕切开，分给了邻居。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为split；现在分词为splitting。

cards.example_en: A sharp swing in public opinion can encourage governments to reconsider policies that previously enjoyed widespread support.
cards.example_zh: 公众意见的急剧转变可能促使政府重新审视此前获得广泛支持的政策。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为swung；不是swinged。

cards.example_en: She missed our picnic because of a sudden illness.
cards.example_zh: 她突然生病，没能参加我们的野餐。
cards.explain_zh: 泛指生病时不可数；指具体疾病时可数。

cards.example_en: The journalist interviewed our neighbour about the new park.
cards.example_zh: 那位记者就新公园的事采访了我们的邻居。
cards.explain_zh: journalist泛指新闻工作者，reporter更侧重采访报道。

cards.example_en: A sudden gust blew my hat into the pond.
cards.example_zh: 一阵突如其来的风把我的帽子吹进了池塘。
cards.explain_zh: sudden是形容词；修饰动作通常用suddenly。

cards.example_en: I saw an advertisement for bicycles at the station.
cards.example_zh: 我在车站看到了一则自行车广告。
cards.explain_zh: 广告内容用 for 引出；advertising 泛指广告活动。

cards.example_en: I saw an advertisement for bicycles at the station.
cards.example_zh: 我在车站看到了一则自行车广告。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Her results have been consistent all year.
cards.example_zh: 她全年的成绩都很稳定。

cards.example_en: This café was originally a small shop selling flowers.
cards.example_zh: 这家咖啡馆原先是一间卖花的小店。
cards.explain_zh: 表示最初情况，常暗示后来有变化；不等于currently。

cards.example_en: She stepped aside to let the cyclist pass.
cards.example_zh: 她走到一旁，让骑自行车的人过去。
cards.explain_zh: aside通常是副词；“除……以外”用aside from。

cards.example_en: I enjoyed the comfort of a warm bed after camping.
cards.example_zh: 露营后，我享受着温暖床铺带来的舒适。
cards.explain_zh: 表示舒适或慰藉时通常不可数；作动词直接接人。

cards.example_en: Firstly, the flat is affordable; secondly, it has a balcony.
cards.example_zh: 首先，这套公寓租金实惠；其次，它还有阳台。
cards.explain_zh: 用于列举第二点，句首使用时后面通常加逗号。

cards.example_en: Severe storms knocked down several trees near our house.
cards.example_zh: 猛烈的暴风雨刮倒了我们家附近的几棵树。
cards.explain_zh: 可修饰疼痛、天气、短缺或惩罚，表示程度重。

cards.example_en: This gene can influence the colour of a cat's fur.
cards.example_zh: 这种基因会影响猫的毛色。
cards.explain_zh: gene是可数名词；genetics指遗传学。

cards.example_en: The prospect of a beach holiday cheered us up.
cards.example_zh: 想到即将去海边度假，我们的心情好了起来。
cards.explain_zh: 前景常用复数prospects；of后可接动名词。

cards.example_en: The prospect of a beach holiday cheered us up.
cards.example_zh: 想到即将去海边度假，我们的心情好了起来。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Fresh snow covered the garden when we woke up.
cards.example_zh: 我们醒来时，新下的雪覆盖了花园。
cards.explain_zh: snow作名词通常不可数；下雪用it snows。

cards.example_en: Heavy snow can disrupt public transport and prevent rural communities from accessing essential services.
cards.example_zh: 大雪可能扰乱公共交通，使农村社区无法获得基本服务。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The film had a simple but exciting plot.
cards.example_zh: 这部电影的情节简单却扣人心弦。
cards.explain_zh: plot指情节；作动词还可表示标绘数据。

cards.example_en: He wrapped a warm scarf around his neck.
cards.example_zh: 他在脖子上围了一条暖和的围巾。
cards.explain_zh: neck指脖子；throat指喉咙，勿混用。

cards.example_en: Office workers may experience neck pain if their computer screens are positioned at an unsuitable height.
cards.example_zh: 如果电脑屏幕的高度不合适，办公室职员可能会感到颈部疼痛。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: This flat meets all our criteria for a home.
cards.example_zh: 这套公寓符合我们对住房的所有要求。
cards.explain_zh: criteria是复数，单数为criterion；用criteria are。

cards.example_en: I use my tablet primarily for reading books.
cards.example_zh: 我的平板电脑主要用来看书。
cards.explain_zh: 通常表示“主要”，不是表示先后顺序的“首先”。

cards.example_en: Schools should integrate digital tools into classroom activities while ensuring that all students have equal access.
cards.example_zh: 学校应将数字工具融入课堂活动，同时确保所有学生都能平等使用。
cards.explain_zh: 常用integrate A into B，也可用integrate A with B。

cards.example_en: He can't accept criticism.
cards.example_zh: 他不能接受批评。

cards.example_en: By convention, guests wait until everyone is seated before eating.
cards.example_zh: 按照惯例，客人等所有人落座后才开始用餐。
cards.explain_zh: 惯例与大会通常可数；by convention意为按惯例。

cards.example_en: An international convention can strengthen environmental protection by establishing shared responsibilities for participating countries.
cards.example_zh: 国际公约可以通过确立参与国的共同责任来加强环境保护。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I bet you left your keys in the kitchen.
cards.example_zh: 我敢说你把钥匙落在厨房了。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词通常仍是bet；I bet常表确信。

cards.example_en: Some investors bet on emerging technologies despite considerable uncertainty about their future commercial success.
cards.example_zh: 一些投资者押注新兴技术，尽管这些技术未来能否取得商业成功仍很不确定。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Flexible working arrangements can help companies retain experienced employees while improving overall job satisfaction.
cards.example_zh: 灵活的工作安排能帮助企业留住经验丰富的员工，同时提高整体工作满意度。
cards.explain_zh: 正式用词，直接接宾语；记住知识也可用retain。

cards.example_en: Arrange these pictures in the correct sequence before dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭前把这些图片按正确顺序排好。
cards.explain_zh: a sequence of后接复数名词，表示一连串事物。

cards.example_en: Arrange these pictures in the correct sequence before dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭前把这些图片按正确顺序排好。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: She chose a plain white shirt for the interview.
cards.example_zh: 她选了一件朴素的白衬衫去参加面试。
cards.explain_zh: plain可指无花纹；平原用名词plain。

cards.example_en: Public health advice should use plain language so that everyone can understand essential information.
cards.example_zh: 公共卫生建议应使用浅显的语言，让每个人都能理解关键信息。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A volunteer helped us carry the boxes upstairs.
cards.example_zh: 一位志愿者帮我们把箱子搬上了楼。
cards.explain_zh: 自愿做某事用volunteer to do；voluntary是常用形容词。

cards.example_en: My grandparents live in a quiet rural village.
cards.example_zh: 我的祖父母住在一个安静的乡村。
cards.explain_zh: rural修饰乡村事物，urban修饰城市事物。

cards.example_en: She stayed calm when the lights suddenly went out.
cards.example_zh: 灯突然熄灭时，她依然保持镇静。
cards.explain_zh: calm中的l不发音；calm down表示平静下来。

cards.example_en: We had to abandon our car in the snow.
cards.example_zh: 我们不得不将车弃在雪地里。
cards.explain_zh: abandon直接接宾语；名词常见于with abandon。

cards.example_en: She felt relieved when her final examination was over.
cards.example_zh: 最后一场考试结束后，她松了一口气。
cards.explain_zh: 考试义口语常简称exam；检查义常接of。

cards.example_en: We sat in silence as the snow fell outside.
cards.example_zh: 外面下着雪，我们静静地坐着。
cards.explain_zh: in silence意为默默地；silent是形容词。

cards.example_en: We sat in silence as the snow fell outside.
cards.example_zh: 外面下着雪，我们静静地坐着。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Dark clouds spread rapidly across the sky before lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭前，乌云迅速布满天空。
cards.explain_zh: 表示速度快，不等于表示立刻的immediately。

cards.example_en: As urban populations grow rapidly, public transport systems must expand to meet increasing demand.
cards.example_zh: 随着城市人口迅速增长，公共交通系统必须扩展，以满足不断增加的需求。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Our new washing machine is quieter and more efficient.
cards.example_zh: 我们的新洗衣机更安静，也更节能。
cards.explain_zh: efficient强调少浪费；effective强调达到预期效果。

cards.example_en: The museum has a room devoted to the revolution.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆有一个专门介绍这场革命的展厅。
cards.explain_zh: revolution强调根本变革；reform通常指渐进改革。

cards.example_en: The digital revolution has transformed education by allowing students to access learning materials from almost anywhere.
cards.example_zh: 数字革命让学生几乎随时随地都能获取学习资料，从而改变了教育。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The children squealed with delight when the puppy arrived.
cards.example_zh: 小狗一来，孩子们就高兴得尖叫起来。
cards.explain_zh: delighted形容人感到高兴；delightful形容事物令人愉快。

cards.example_en: The children squealed with delight when the puppy arrived.
cards.example_zh: 小狗一来，孩子们就高兴得尖叫起来。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Access to vocational training can improve employment prospects for young people in economically disadvantaged regions.
word.example_zh: 获得职业培训的机会能改善经济欠发达地区年轻人的就业前景。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Fresh snow covered the garden when we woke up.
word.example_zh: 我们醒来时，新下的雪覆盖了花园。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: I bet you left your keys in the kitchen.

word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Investment in public transport can improve access to employment for people living in rural areas.
word.example_zh: 投资公共交通可以让农村居民更容易获得就业机会。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
